newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinney Inv mulls to spinoff piling unit.
newsitem.headline: Chinney Inv mulls to spinoff piling unit.

text.p: Building construction and trading concern Chinney Investments Ltd said on Monday it proposed to seek a separate listing for its foundation piling subsidiary on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
"Application will be made to the stock exchange for a listing of the subsidiary," the company said in a statement.
Chinney said there was no assurance that approval for listing would be granted.
The company shares were down HK$0.075 to HK$2.15 at midday.
